slides.explanation: You can now grab a 14 percent discount on Google Workspace plans for the next three months. This deal covers the Starter, Standard, and Plus tiers if you are looking to trim your business software costs.

slides.headline: Disney D23 Event Highlights

slides.headline: A Phone Grip Worth Buying
slides.explanation: After years of testing magnetic phone accessories, one reviewer finally found a keeper in the OhSnap Snap Grip Stand. It is a 50 dollar upgrade that manages to fix the flaws found in cheaper alternatives.

slides.headline: The Best Apple Watch Bands
slides.explanation: Testing watch bands since 2015 has led to a new roundup of the top options on the market. Whether you need something for sports or a formal event, there are picks from brands like Nike and Hermés.

slides.headline: New Indie Games to Play
slides.explanation: This week's indie game roundup highlights titles inspired by classic 90s hits. If you are looking for something new, there are fresh games featuring dogs, cats, and even sheep.
